draftError.hbFulfilledStock: Hepsiburada manages the stock of this listing (fulfilled by Hepsiburada)

listing.notFound: This listing isn't in your Hepsiburada list. Refresh listings and try again.
listing.saved: Draft saved. Nothing changes on Hepsiburada until you send it.
listing.sentPending: Sent. Hepsiburada is processing the update; it usually takes a few minutes.
listing.nothingToSend: Nothing to send: the values already match Hepsiburada
listing.sendFailedKey: Hepsiburada didn't accept the change. Check the values and try again.
listing.restrictedNoReason: Hepsiburada didn't give a reason. Check the listing in your Hepsiburada panel.
listing.lastSendFailed: The last send failed. Fix the values and send again.
listing.syncing: Hepsiburada is processing your last update
listing.contentNote: Title, photos and attributes are managed in Hepsiburada's catalog.
listing.dispatchTimeHelp: Days until you hand the package to the cargo company
listing.draftNote: These values are a draft. Send them to update Hepsiburada.

create.title: New Hepsiburada product
create.modeImportHelp: Creates the product in Hepsiburada's catalog. Hepsiburada reviews it first; it appears in your listings once approved.
create.modeFastHelp: The product already exists on Hepsiburada with this barcode. You only add your price and stock; no review needed.
create.importDone: Hepsiburada accepted the product. It will appear in your listings after the next refresh.
create.fastDone: Listed. It will appear in your listings after the next refresh.
create.merchantSkuHelp: Your own stock code; it must be unique in your store
create.imagesHelp: Up to 5 https links, one per line. The first is the main photo.
